message.entry: The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the system base is net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA ({0} MVA).

The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the given {0} MVA differs from the system base net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA = {1} MVA, which is used. Set net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA instead.

Continuation_Power_Flow(net, opt) is deprecated: use [result, flag] = net.calculate_continuation_powerflow(LoadBus=opt.CPFBus). The v3 options map to LoadBus, InitialLambda, MaxIteration, StepSize, ArcLength and UseInternalState; result.rm_x is the old CPF_Result.x_sol.

CsvNetHandler.import(path, net) is deprecated: use net = PowerNetwork.import(path) for a new network, or PowerNetwork.import(path, Network=obj) to load into an existing one (e.g. in the constructor of a network class).
CsvNetHandler.export(net, ModelName, savepath=folder) is deprecated: use net.export(fullfile(folder, "@"+ModelName)). The folder now also holds network/parameter.csv with Hz and baseMVA.

The positional point get_sys(x, V, u) of a {0} is deprecated: use get_sys(Point=p), with p in the order of the variables of the layer (states, voltage, inputs; for a component, comp.get_variable_map()).
